messages:
maria: Quick runbook thread for launch posts + webinar. Need SEO checklist that covers keywords, schema, internal linking, hreflang (APAC), and redirects. Also confirm lead routing to SFDC campaign.

sam: Ill own KW -> content briefs. plan: 4 clusters (benchmarking, cost calc, demo intent, enterprise controls). will flag high-intent KW for webinar CTAs.

jake: Ill take schema + meta. adding Event, FAQPage, and Speakership JSON-LD. also will add meta robots + canonical rules.

olivia: Ill do internal linking + redirect diff. propose: pillar pages stay live, retired posts -> 301 to pillar. create /go/ shortlinks (307 for tracking) for campaign emails.

kevin-salesops: For SFDC mapping: use campaign=WEB-LAUNCH-3601, source=webinar; please include hidden form field campaign for each landing form. I will validate after staging.

maria: Add hreflang for en-US and en-GB; APAC will use en and regional pages later. Sam please note target country tags in KW sheet.

sam: KW seed uploaded: https://drive.redwood/seo/kw-seed-3601234567.csv includes intent, locale hints, meta title suggestions, and CTA per page. DEMO intent rows marked.

jake: JSON-LD snippet for webinar (example): {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Benchmarking Workshop","startDate":"2026-07-20T17:00:00Z","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}

olivia: Redirect plan: export current rules, diff with proposed CSV, detect chains >2 hops, flag collisions. will run redirect-smoke on staging: `curl -I -L -o /dev/null -w "%{url_effective} %{http_code}" https://redwood.ai/old-path`

maria: Rules: 301 for permanent, 307 for tracking shortlinks, avoid chains, prefer single-hop canonicalize. if >4 backlinks externally, do 301 to best-match pillar and notify salesops.

seo-ci-bot: CI: redirect-diff queued. Upload CSV to /marketing/seo/redirects/launch-3601234567.csv to run.

sam: Also proposing meta experiment: two title variants for benchmark post. A: "Benchmark Inference Costs — Redwood Results" B: "How to Cut Inference Costs: Benchmarks & Tips" mark A/B in KW sheet.

jake: QA checklist: 1) JSON-LD passes Rich Results, 2) canonical header present, 3) hreflang tags correct, 4) no duplicate meta descriptions across pillars.

olivia: Internal linking rules: 1) pillar links to all cluster pages, 2) cluster links back to pillar (contextual), 3) no more than 3 CTAs per page, 4) add jump links for long benchmarks. I'll post link diff by EOD.

kevin-salesops: Confirmed will automate SFDC campaign membership on form submission via hidden campaign param + GTM event. Need staging forms wired.

maria: Monitoring: add Search Console property check, GA4 event for webinar signup, and daily redirect-error alert to #marketing for 48h postlaunch. Also track impressions for benchmark KW for 2 weeks.

sam: Noted. Ill include target KPIs in sheet: impressions, CTR, webinar signups (by KW), demo requests.

jake: Pushed schema partial to docs repo under /docs/seo/includes/event-jsonld.html and added a Next.js include example.

olivia: Uploaded redirect CSV to shared drive and will post to CI once final. Then Ill run smoke test and share curl logs.

seo-ci-bot: Preflight status: 2/6 (KW sheet, schema partial). Waiting for redirect CSV, internal-link diff, hreflang verification, tracking wiring.

maria: Final thing: sequence for retired blog posts -> create redirect map, update sitemap.xml, and submit reindex request for moved URLs. Olivia please handle sitemap update.

olivia: Will update sitemap and submit index via Search Console after staging pass. ETA: 36h.

maria: Great. Tag here when each item done. Were aiming to publish + webinar in 9 business days.

kevin-salesops: Ill run a quick SFDC smoke after forms wired and confirm campaign counts.

sam: will lock KW sheet after a final pass tonight.

jake: Will run Rich Results test and post a screenshot if it passes.

olivia: Post staging curl output here when smoke tests complete.
